scientific_limitations: Finite-state, constant-rate Markov generators only; result concerns exact Crank–Nicolson endpoint entrywise positivity, not stage positivity or nonlinear problems.
No complexity guarantee for recovering first-return distributions in large state spaces.

title: Nonreversible return laws give a single sharp Crank–Nicolson positivity window
